title: Building – The use of an aluminium panel system utilizing polyamide inserts – August 2016
description: An architectural firm sought a building permit for a building required to be of noncombustible construction, clad in an aluminum panel system with polyamide thermal-break inserts. The municipality refused the permit.

refusal.basis: analogous: building permit refusal (no alternative solution filed). The decisive gap was missing CAN/ULC-S134 test evidence.

outcome_summary: Refusal confirmed on the ABC 2014 3.1.5.5 (CAN/ULC-S134) ground only. The panel accepted the minor-combustible-component and non-structural arguments and urged an alternative-solution application.
